attributes.name: hero shadow elevation
attributes.definition: Whether and how box shadows are applied to the hero section or hero card to create depth.

values.definition: Hero has a clearly visible, pronounced drop shadow, often combined with transforms for depth.
Hero or hero card has a light, soft shadow used sparingly.
Shadow treatment on the hero that fits none of the above.

attributes.name: shadow usage extent
attributes.definition: How widely box shadows and depth effects are used across page surfaces.

values.definition: Shadows and transforms are used across many surfaces for depth.
Shadows appear only on a few key elements such as the hero and key images.
Shadows are not used on the page.
